label: Blob cursor
desc: A gooey blob chases the pointer with droplets that stretch behind it and merge back; it swells over links and buttons, squashes on press and follows keyboard focus.
use: Over a hero or portfolio section as a playful pointer follower (wraps its content; add global to cover the page).

label: Crosshair
desc: Full-length guide lines, edge rulers, a reticle and a live x / y readout follow the pointer; keyboard focus moves them onto the focused element.
use: Design tools, coordinate pickers, blueprint-style or technical product sections (wraps its content).

label: Cursor grid
desc: A lattice of dots that swell, warm up and bend away from the pointer, then cool down; taps send a ring through the grid.
use: Hero backdrops and feature sections that should react to the pointer (wraps its content).

label: Ghost cursor
desc: A translucent glowing ghost pointer drifts behind the real one, trailing fading afterimages and a wavering wisp; it wanders and taps by itself when idle.
use: Atmospheric landing sections and demos that show 'someone else' using the page (wraps its content).

label: Glare hover
desc: A glossy band sweeps across the wrapped content away from the edge the pointer entered by; focus and taps replay it, touch plays it on a timer.
use: Wrap a card, image, button or pricing tier to give it a premium sheen on hover.

label: Image trail
desc: Images drop along the pointer path at regular distances, pop in tilted, drift on and fade out; taps drop a burst, idle plays a ghost trail.
use: Portfolio, agency and gallery hero sections (pass your own image URLs via images).

label: Pixel trail
desc: Square pixels light up under the pointer and fade out in crisp steps, leaving a pixel-art trail; taps burst, idle paints by itself.
use: Retro, game or developer-tool sections as a playful pointer trail (wraps its content).

label: Splash cursor
desc: The pointer stirs a small live fluid: ink in the theme colours swirls, curls and fades; a press bursts outward; reduced motion shows a still frame.
use: Hero sections for creative or music products that want a fluid, colourful pointer reaction (wraps its content).

label: Swarm cursor
desc: A small flock of agents flies after the pointer, orbiting it at rest and stretching out when it moves; a press scatters them.
use: Playful landing sections and 404 pages (wraps its content).

label: Target cursor
desc: Four corner brackets spin around the pointer and snap onto links and buttons you hover or focus; touch cycles through targets and locks onto taps.
use: Dashboards, game or sci-fi styled pages where interactive elements should feel 'lockable' (wraps its content; selector chooses the targets).
